latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — expert-level video editing with ffmpeg and Python.

- Supports trimming, cropping, resizing, rotating, joining, and compressing videos
- Handles audio tasks: add, replace, remove, extract, and normalize audio tracks
- Enables subtitle embedding, text overlay, watermarking, and batch operations
- Provides workflow guidelines: analyze, plan, chain filters, execute, verify, and optimize
- Includes advanced effects: speed change, color grading, stabilization, GIF/thumbnail creation, and format conversion
